LAME (libmp3lame)

The LAME developers. https://lame.sourceforge.io/

LAME is linked into xsystem4.exe as a part of libsndfile (MSYS2's mingw-w64-x86_64-lame).
It is licensed under the GNU Library General Public License, version 2 or (at your option)
any later version. RQ MOD takes it under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1,
whose text is in ../ffmpeg/COPYING.LGPLv2.1.

The source of LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.io/download.php
